note: Pinned pricing snapshot for the Phase 4 SCREENING window. All four billed token classes per provider/model, USD per million tokens (usd_per_mtok). Prices are published LIST rates retrieved from the cited pages on the date below; re-confirm at CP-SPEND. Provider keys and model/selector keys MUST match manifest/delivery-manifest.yaml exactly (costing.py keys prices[providers][provider][model_or_selector]). This snapshot does NOT supersede pricing/prices-2026-07-19.json: batch-3 runs stay priced by the snapshot they were run under.
effort_level_note: Effort level changes token CONSUMPTION, not the per-token rate. 'Gemini 3.7 Flash (High)' and 'Gemini 3.7 Flash (Medium)' therefore share one rate-card entry STRUCTURE with identical rates, but they are separate keys because manifest/delivery-manifest.yaml pins them as separate selectors (PRODUCT_B_ECON_TIER vs PRODUCT_B_ECON_TIER_MED) and the C3 vs C3-med arm exists precisely to measure the consumption difference. Never collapse the two keys: costing.py looks up by the verbatim selector label, and a merged key would silently merge the two arms.

sources.basis: Anthropic published list rates (Vertex global-endpoint tracks these; regional/multi-region endpoints add a documented +10% premium — see regional_premium_note per model). Same basis as the 2026-07-19 snapshot. cache_write in this rate card is the 5-MINUTE cache-write rate (1.25x base input); the 1-hour rate (2x base input) is recorded per model as cache_write_1h_note but is NOT what costing.py bills — see cache_write_ttl_caveat.

Google published Gemini paid-tier list rates. SURFACE CAVEAT: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing could not be retrieved on this date (the page did not render in the fetch), so the Gemini rows below are sourced from the Gemini API pricing page instead. Vertex-vs-Gemini-API rate parity for the 3.7/3.6 Flash generation is NOT verified in this snapshot — see verify_at_cp_spend. cache_read = published context-caching read price; cache_write = base input rate (Google bills cache-creation tokens as standard input on first pass; no separate per-token cache-write premium is published — the separate charge is time-based cache STORAGE, see cache_storage_caveat).

verify_at_cp_spend: Gemini rows: confirm the three selector labels price at these rates on the surface Product B actually bills through (Vertex vs Gemini API). Not verified in this snapshot because the Vertex pricing page was unretrievable on 2026-08-16.
Gemini rows: the rates below are PROMOTIONAL through 2026-12-31 (see promotional_pricing_note). If any screening run lands on or after 2027-01-01, re-snapshot before costing it.
Claude rows: confirm Vertex global-endpoint parity with Anthropic list rates, and confirm the endpoint in use is global (CLOUD_ML_REGION=global) so the +10% regional premium does not apply.
cache_write_ttl_caveat: Our schema has ONE cache-write class (usage.cache_creation_tokens) while Product A reports the write split by TTL (usage.cache_creation.{ephemeral_5m_input_tokens, ephemeral_1h_input_tokens}) and the rate card prices the two differently (5m = 1.25x input, 1h = 2x input). Both pin-resolution smokes wrote 5m-TTL only, so this rate card bills the 5m rate. If a 1h-TTL write appears in a screening run, its cost is UNDERSTATED by this card and the run must be re-costed with a TTL split — see report/findings/model-pin-resolution-2026-08-16.md.
cache_storage_caveat: Google prices Gemini context-cache STORAGE per token per HOUR ($0.50 / 1M tokens / hour through 2026-12-31; $1.00 after), which is a time-based charge with no per-token-class equivalent in this rate card. It is therefore NOT captured by costing.py and any Product-B cost derived here EXCLUDES cache storage. This is a stated exclusion, not a zero: do not report a Product-B cost as complete without naming it.
tokenizer_comparability_note: Anthropic documents that Claude 4.7 and later models (which includes claude-opus-5) use a newer tokenizer producing approximately 30% more tokens for the same text, while claude-sonnet-4-6 and earlier use the previous tokenizer. Token COUNTS are therefore not directly comparable across the strong/economical pair pinned for this window; dollar costs are. Any tokens-per-task comparison between claude-opus-5 and claude-sonnet-4-6 must state this.

claude-opus-5@default.cache_write_1h_note: 1-hour cache write = 2x base input = 10.00. Not billed by this card; see cache_write_ttl_caveat.
claude-opus-5@default.regional_premium_note: us-central1 (regional) adds +10% over these global-endpoint list rates: input 5.50, cache_write 6.875, cache_read 0.55, output 27.50. Confirm endpoint choice (global vs regional) at CP-SPEND.
claude-opus-5@default.fast_mode_note: Anthropic lists a separate premium 'fast mode' rate for Claude Opus 5 (input 10.00 / output 50.00), first-party API only and NOT available on partner-operated clouds. Our runs record speed='standard' in the product JSON; this card prices standard speed only.
claude-opus-5@default.pin_note: Vertex publishes only the floating '@default' alias for this model (no dated snapshot) — SPEC 6.3 caveat recorded in report/findings/model-pin-resolution-2026-08-16.md.

claude-sonnet-4-6@default.cache_write_1h_note: 1-hour cache write = 2x base input = 6.00. Not billed by this card; see cache_write_ttl_caveat.
claude-sonnet-4-6@default.regional_premium_note: us-central1 (regional) adds +10%: input 3.30, cache_write 4.125, cache_read 0.33, output 16.50.
claude-sonnet-4-6@default.pin_note: Unchanged from the 2026-07-19 snapshot; re-verified on the source page 2026-08-16. Role changed this window: economical tier (was strong tier).

Gemini 3.7 Flash (High).selector_note: Product B verbatim selector label, confirmed against `agy models` output on 2026-08-16 (row: 'gemini-3.7-flash-high\tGemini 3.7 Flash (High)'). '(High)' is a reasoning-effort tier that raises token VOLUME (reasoning billed as output), not the per-token rate — see effort_level_note. Used only where Product-B token counts exist (product-reported, or provider-side via harness/collectors/vertex_token_collector.py); otherwise cost is recorded unavailable, never zero.
Gemini 3.7 Flash (High).promotional_pricing_note: Source page states these are the rates through 2026-12-31; from 2027-01-01 the listed rates double to input 1.50, output 7.50, cache_read 0.15.
Gemini 3.7 Flash (High).cache_storage_note: Cache storage 0.50 per 1M tokens per hour (1.00 from 2027-01-01) — time-based, excluded from this card. See cache_storage_caveat.

Gemini 3.7 Flash (Medium).selector_note: Product B verbatim selector label, confirmed against `agy models` output on 2026-08-16 (row: 'gemini-3.7-flash-medium\tGemini 3.7 Flash (Medium)'). Kept as a separate key because the manifest pins it as a separate selector (PRODUCT_B_ECON_TIER_MED) and it is the C3-med arm. See effort_level_note.

Gemini 3.6 Flash (High).selector_note: Product B verbatim selector label, confirmed against `agy models` output on 2026-08-16 (row: 'gemini-3.6-flash-high\tGemini 3.6 Flash (High)'). The source page lists the 3.6 Flash and 3.7 Flash rows at identical rates, so a 3.6-vs-3.7 cost difference is a CONSUMPTION difference, not a rate difference — state that wherever the arms are compared.
